headline: Simpsons: Hit & Run might be making a comeback, Matt Groening hints.
summary: Simpsons co-creator Matt Groening hinted at D23 that *Simpsons: Hit & Run* might return. He stated, "I think the original game is coming back in some form." Showrunner Matt Selman added a cautious "or not," leaving fans guessing.

headline: Roleplay as an AI chatbot to mock AI's repetitive nature.
summary: "Your AI Slop Bores Me" is a simple game designed to poke fun at AI. Players roleplay as chatbots, responding to human prompts. The game highlights the humor in AI-generated content's repetitiveness.

headline: Elektron's budget electronic music instruments are a great, overlooked choice.
summary: Elektron's Model:Samples and Model:Cycles are recommended for aspiring electronic musicians. These budget-friendly grooveboxes offer great value. They are often overlooked despite their quality compared to more hyped gear.

headline: Switched on Pop hosts discuss their love for music and the podcast's origins.
summary: "Switched on Pop" is a popular music podcast that deeply analyzes pop songs. Hosts Nate Sloan and Charlie Harding dissect musical choices and theory. The podcast's origin is linked to Carly Rae Jepsen's hit "Call Me Maybe."

headline: Kingdom Hearts 4 will not be delayed past its late 2027 launch, developers confirm.
summary: Kingdom Hearts 4 developers confirmed the game will not be delayed. Co-director Tai Yasue and creator Tetsuya Nomura assured a late 2027 launch. They stated the game's release is "100% thing" for its target window.

headline: Kingdom Hearts 4 unveils extended gameplay trailer featuring playable Mickey, Donald, and Goofy.
summary: An extended gameplay trailer for Kingdom Hearts 4 was showcased at D23 2026. The trailer offered the first look at playable King Mickey. Donald and Goofy were also confirmed as playable characters.

headline: Star Wars: Smuggler's Gambit brings Disneyland's Smuggler's Run to Fortnite.
summary: "Smuggler's Gambit" in Fortnite extends the Disneyland Smuggler's Run experience. It's a PvE multiplayer online game allowing players to aid Hondo Ohnaka. Players can link Epic Games and MyDisney accounts for special in-park unlocks.

headline: Kingdom Hearts creator Tetsuya Nomura teases involvement in upcoming Disney+ anime.
summary: Kingdom Hearts creator Tetsuya Nomura hinted at involvement in a new Disney+ anime. He encouraged fans to "let their imagination run wild" regarding the series. Details about the mysterious Kingdom Hearts anime remain scarce.

headline: UK firefighters under "incredible pressure" amid multiple major incidents.
summary: Major incidents have been declared across England and Wales. Firefighters are facing "incredible pressure" due to widespread blazes. Incidents reported in Stourbridge, Sandwell, and Pershore.

headline: Reform UK proposes welfare overhaul to save £50bn.
summary: Reform UK plans a significant overhaul of the welfare system. The party claims this reform would generate £50 billion in savings. A 50-page detailed plan is expected to be released on Monday.

headline: Indonesia earthquake: Rescuers search for survivors as death toll rises.
summary: Rescuers are actively searching for survivors after a powerful Indonesian earthquake. The earthquake destroyed hundreds of buildings and tragically killed 47 people. Officials are conducting a rapid assessment of the disaster's impact.

headline: Ariana Grande begins UK tour; plans to "step back" after shows.
summary: Ariana Grande's tour has arrived in the UK for 10 dates in London. The star is reportedly stepping back from public life after the tour concludes. She aims to leave personal issues aside for her performances.
